description: Tipologia de tratamento do Esgoto - RJ is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). No Estado do Rio de Janeiro, a maioria dos municípios que dispõe de tratamento de esgoto utiliza o sistema secundário, que consiste na retirada da matéria orgânica por processos biológicos. Alguns municípios, como São Gonçalo, Barra Mansa, Iguaba Grande, Paracambi e Volta Redonda têm estações de tratamento primário e secundário. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Downloadable Data, ESTADO DO AMBIENTE, SANEAMENTO, INEA, RIO DE JANEIRO. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
